title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Cindy Zapata is the Assistant Director of the Harvard Immigration and Refugee Clinical Program and a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School. She is also a Senior Clinical Instructor in the Harvard Immigration and Refugee Clinic, where she supervises and trains law students representing clients in matters before the Immigration Court, Board of Immigration […]
